{{recipe}}

Here are very simple and very delicious cookies!

== Ingredients ==
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*2 sticks (1 cup, 8 ounces, or 225 g) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted
*3 cups [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
*[[Cookbook:Chocolate|Chocolate chips]] (optional)
*[[Cookbook:Rolled Oats|Oats]] (optional)

== Procedure ==
#Heat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350°F (175°C).
#Combine the sugar and melted butter.
#Mix in the flour until you have a thick [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]].
#Mix in the chocolate chips and oats, if using.
#Shape the dough into your desired cookie shapes. Transfer to a greased or [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment]]-lined [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]].
#Put the cookies in the oven. [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] until the cookies are a golden colour and are hard (probably 8–12 minutes, depending on size), and then take them out.
